title: Spanish actors confront a ‘dark chapter’ in PH-Spain history in ‘Los Salvajes Bravos’

blocks.text: For Spanish actors Andreas Muñoz and Marta Codina, portraying two key figures in the Filipino film “Los Salvajes Bravos” offered an opportunity to explore the complex history between Spain and the Philippines and, at the same time, served as a way to honor the Filipinos who endured injustices under the colonial era. “Los Salvajes Bravos,” an official entry to the 2026 Metro Manila Film Festival, revisits the 1887 Philippine Exposition in Madrid where Indigenous Filipinos were exhibited in a display that some historians have described as a “human zoo.” “My first reaction when I learned the story was one of sheer […]...
